value_updates.referral_operation: For NFTs minted by the new active contract, each mint number is its permanent referral code; old-contract NFT mint numbers are excluded from project systems. Successful coded referrals earn $5 and a current Small Block ticket, while a mint without a valid referral code sends the commission and ticket to a random eligible holder in the new active contract.
value_updates.prize_ticket_rules: Each successful coded referral in the new active contract earns a current Small Block ticket; more tickets provide more chances, tickets expire after the Small Block draw, and old-contract tickets are excluded from the restarted draw system.

decisions.reason: Restarting NFT and draw state under the new contract does not change the automatic prize-transfer workflow or winner notification channels.
The source decision excludes old-contract NFTs and draw state but does not change prize-pool funding amounts, funding sale types, duration, or the active pool.
The contract restart does not change the $5 coded-referral commission or the award of one Small Block ticket; contract-specific referral eligibility is owned by separate Requirements.
